answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with slashable stake plus vouching. To enter the oasis, a newcomer locks a bond and needs two established agents to vouch; each voucher is staked too. A fake haven of identities therefore needs real collateral and a web of accomplices. Peers inspect the trust graph through a prism of timing and funding correlations, then slash linked clusters, so flooding the network costs far more than honest work.
